description: Purpose: substitution economics compute for carbon black - given a native price (vcb_price_input), an rCB price (rcb_price_input) and replacement ratio, returns per-ton saving and optional annualized value. Guidelines: supply your own quotes, or fetch market anchors via get_rcb_index first. Limits: pure arithmetic - no market data access, not a price recommendation. Ex: 'N330 12000 RMB/t vs rCB 8000 RMB/t, ratio 0.3, annual 5000t'.

annual_volume_t.description: 可选，年用量（吨），用于年化

rcb_price_input.description: rCB 价格（正数，调用方提供）

vcb_price_input.description: 原生炭黑价格（正数，调用方提供）

name: calculate_saving

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).

title: Calculate rCB Cost Saving
